name: One More Thing
description: List what you remember from the lesson; two classmates add what you missed, and your list comes back grown.
when: When you want to see what the class actually remembers, and have them fill each other's gaps.

recall:
Plants make their own food from sunlight
It happens in the leaves
They need water and carbon dioxide

Photosynthesis happens in chloroplasts
Chlorophyll makes leaves green
Oxygen comes out as a waste product

Sunlight plus water plus carbon dioxide makes sugar and oxygen
The sugar is glucose
Plants store extra as starch

Carbon dioxide comes in through tiny holes in the leaves
The holes are called stomata
Water comes up from the roots

The equation has to balance
It is the opposite of respiration
Animals depend on it for oxygen

It only happens when there is light
The leaf is like a solar panel
Without it there is no food chain

Glucose is the plant's energy
Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light, not green
That is why leaves look green

Roots bring water, leaves catch light
Carbon dioxide comes from the air
Oxygen goes back into the air

lines: Also: the food it makes is a sugar called glucose
Missing: it needs water from the roots too
Add: all of this happens inside the chloroplasts
Also: sunlight is the energy that powers the whole thing
Missing: the outputs are glucose and oxygen
Add: the green pigment that catches the light is chlorophyll
Missing: carbon dioxide gets in through the stomata
Also: extra glucose gets stored as starch
Connection: this is why cutting down forests matters for the air we breathe
Add: photosynthesis and respiration are opposites of each other
Missing: the whole food chain starts here
Add: less light means less photosynthesis, which is why plants lean toward windows
Connection: the oxygen in this room came out of a leaf
Add: the glucose also builds the plant's body, not just its energy
Missing: chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light and reflects green
Add: the equation balances, six of each on both sides

intro.message:
ONE MORE THING

From memory, no notes! You'll list what you remember from today's lesson. Then your list travels: two classmates will each add one thing you missed.

It comes back to you, grown.

recall.prompt: From memory (no notes!): list the 2-3 most important things you remember from today's lesson. Put each on its own line.

add-one.prompt:
A classmate's list is above, their lines are locked in. ADD one thing they missed: a detail, a missing point, or a connection between ideas.

(List looking empty or thin? Start it yourself, write the biggest thing YOU remember.)

add-again.prompt: A different classmate's list, already grown once. Read the whole thing, then ADD one more thing it's still missing.

returned.hostTemplate:
Everyone's list just came back to its owner, grown by two classmates.

Give the room a quiet minute to read before continuing.

cluster.instruction: These are memory lists about today's lesson, each grown by three different students. Combine them into ONE master list of what the class collectively remembered: most-mentioned ideas first, grouped by theme, duplicates merged. End by naming one or two things that only a single list caught, credit the catch, not the student.

class-memory.discussionPrompt: Which line came from someone else? What did the class remember together that nobody had alone?

end.message: That's One More Thing, nobody's list came back the same size it left. Edit the prompts to run it on any lesson.
